items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Fats, I knew him. Freddie Hubbard. You call some good names.

ctx.x: Let's see. What about Fats Navarro or Freddie Hubbard?
Fats, I knew him. Freddie Hubbard. You call some good names.
Yeah. They was marvelous and I admired them. Fats left us too, didn't he?
